newsitem.title: USA: Sirena takes steps to cut costs.
newsitem.headline: Sirena takes steps to cut costs.

text.p: Sirena Corp said on Thursday that it had implemented cost reductions and adjusted production schedules to control inventory in a "difficult environment."
Under the plan, management has cut overall non-piecework-employee head count and initiated cost-control measures aimed at reducing selling, general and administrative costs by 20 percent, it said.

In reporting fourth quarter results, it said it had provided certain receivable reserves and inventory write-downs of $1.6 million and recorded a $200,000 charge for employee severance and costs associated with consolidation.
